[[Kurmauzeh]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}}

==Dialogue==
:''"They say it can't be done, but I'll show them. I am the greatest juggler that Vabbi has ever seen. If anyone can juggle [[geode]]s, it is the Flying Kurmauzeh. I only have one problem. I dropped all of my geodes and they cracked open. Damn [[Harpy|skree harpies]]. Anyway, now I can't practice. I'm close. I know it. I just need 5 Geodes so I can get back to work. I can give you something the audience threw at me... I mean to me... during my last performance:"''
